title: Anchorage stats
description: Between two hairlines that fade out at both ends: a centred heading over three huge, thin figures in a white-to-cobalt gradient, each with a small cobalt caption. A soft blue glow rises from the left edge. The figures count up and fade in one after another as they scroll into view.
notes: the count-up needs JavaScript (static HTML shows the final figures); the fade-in is CSS scroll-driven
three across even on phones, as the original; best with short figures ("7+", "2K+", "3.1B")
